comment: WITHHELD UNTIL DISCLOSURE. Steps whose purpose is to reproduce the two Ruby account-holder rename defects (the authorization gap and the crash that follows a rename that gap lets through). They are excluded from every release package: this directory must not ship until the maintainers have been told privately. The battery loads this file ONLY when it is present and prints `[withheld until disclosure] NOT RUN: <n> steps` when it is absent (tools/parity-side-effects/compare.mjs and tests/tools/side-effects-scenario-battery.test.ts). Re-record the Ruby trace over the PUBLIC scenario list before shipping; the recording committed at reference-harness/fixtures/write-battery-v1/expected/side-effects-ruby.json still carries these steps.
